settings.title: Care Guide
settings.intro: Protect your investment with a simple routine built for raw, single-donor hair. Follow these steps to keep your extensions soft, shiny, and tangle-free.

settings.heading: Wash day
settings.text:
Detangle gently from ends to roots before getting hair wet. Use lukewarm water and a sulfate-free shampoo — focus on the scalp and weft area, not the mid-lengths. Rinse thoroughly.

  • Wash every 7–14 days, or when product buildup appears
  • Never rub hair together; squeeze and rinse downward
  • Pat dry with a microfiber towel — do not wring

settings.heading: Condition & moisture
settings.text:
Apply a moisturizing conditioner from mid-shaft to ends. Leave on 5–10 minutes under a shower cap for extra hydration. Rinse with cool water to seal the cuticle.

For curly and wavy textures, follow with a leave-in conditioner and light oil on the ends only.

settings.heading: Drying & heat
settings.text: Air-dry whenever possible. If you use a blow dryer, use low heat and a diffuser on curly textures. Always apply a heat protectant before flat ironing or curling — keep tools under 350°F (175°C).

settings.heading: Night routine
settings.text: Braid hair loosely or wrap in a silk scarf before bed. Sleep on a silk or satin pillowcase to reduce friction and preserve your install.

settings.heading: Storage between wears
settings.text: Store clean, fully dry hair in a breathable satin bag. Keep away from direct sunlight and humidity. Lightly mist with leave-in before reinstalling if hair feels dry.

settings.heading: What to avoid
settings.text:
• Heavy oils at the root or lace base
  • Products with alcohol, sulfates, or heavy silicones
  • Brushing wet hair aggressively
  • Chlorine and salt water without rinsing immediately after
